column1: # Stations to track. Edit freely — ids are the only thing that must stay stable
#   home       your home station — the one savings are measured against
#              the one the panel labels HOME. At most one. If none is set the
#              baseline falls back to the cheapest `regular`.
#   regular    a station you'd default to. Baseline fallback when no home is set.
#   favourite  one you actively like / would detour for.
#   tracked    watched for history and prediction only.
# label is what fits the device header — keep it under 18 characters.
